event_summary.short: Officer initiated a traffic stop on a suspected intoxicated driver who ran over a curb. The suspect refused to comply, was arrested, and later found to possess a loaded firearm with defaced serial number, methamphetamine, and other drug paraphernalia.

evidence.quote: On January 16th, 2023, an officer witnessed a possible intoxicated driver recklessly run over a sidewalk.
